title: A sensitivity study of hydrogen mixing with cushion gases for effective storage in porous media
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01400F, Paper
Open Access

Junhan Lu, Nasiru Salahu Muhammed, Jude A. Okolie, Emmanuel I. Epelle
CH4 enhances hydrogen recovery but has a higher mixing tendency compared to N2 and CO2. H2 purity and recovery are more sensitive to changes in permeability than porosity. The mixing zone is more sensitive to changes in porosity than permeability.
